Mensabot Monitor
================

The ``Mensabot Monitor`` is a graphical monitoring application for the HSK-MensaBot. It combines a ROS 2 monitoring node with a PyQt6-based graphical user interface to visualize the current robot state, safety information and diagnostic data in real time.

The application subscribes to the most relevant ROS topics of the robot software stack and presents the received information in a unified dashboard. In addition, it provides live velocity plots, a topic watchdog and status indicators to simplify system monitoring during development, testing and operation.

Purpose
-------

The application provides the following functionality:

* Displays the current robot pose and motion.
* Visualizes the complete velocity command chain.
* Displays the current navigation goal state.
* Monitors the hardware connection state.
* Displays the current emergency stop state.
* Visualizes the active LiDAR monitoring field.
* Displays the active speed limit.
* Monitors front and rear safety scanner states.
* Displays IMU measurements.
* Provides a topic watchdog for communication diagnostics.
* Visualizes live linear and angular velocity plots.

Launch Command
--------------

The monitoring application can be started using:

.. code-block:: bash

   python3 src/mensabot_utils/mensabot_utils/mensabot_monitor.py


Subscribed Topics
-----------------

+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| Topic                                          | Message Type                              | Description                                                  |
+================================================+===========================================+==============================================================+
| ``/odom``                                      | ``nav_msgs/Odometry``                     | Robot pose and velocity.                                     |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/cmd_vel_smoothed``                          | ``geometry_msgs/Twist``                   | Smoothed velocity command generated by Nav2.                 |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/safety/cmd_vel``                            | ``geometry_msgs/Twist``                   | Velocity command after safety filtering.                     |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/mensabot_base_controller/cmd_vel_out``      | ``geometry_msgs/TwistStamped``            | Velocity command forwarded to the robot controller.          |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/hardware/connected``                        | ``std_msgs/Bool``                         | Hardware connection state.                                   |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/safety/manual_override``                    | ``std_msgs/Bool``                         | Manual override status.                                      |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/safety/estop``                              | ``std_msgs/Bool``                         | Emergency stop status.                                       |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/safety/field_state``                        | ``std_msgs/String``                       | Active LiDAR monitoring field.                               |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/speed_limit``                               | ``nav2_msgs/SpeedLimit``                  | Active speed limitation.                                     |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/lidars/front/output_paths``                 | ``sick_safetyscanners2_interfaces/OutputPaths`` | Front safety scanner status.                           |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/lidars/rear/output_paths``                  | ``sick_safetyscanners2_interfaces/OutputPaths`` | Rear safety scanner status.                            |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/navigate_to_pose/_action/status``           | ``action_msgs/GoalStatusArray``           | Current navigation goal status.                              |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| ``/imu/data``                                  | ``sensor_msgs/Imu``                       | IMU orientation and angular velocity.                        |
+------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+

Displayed Information
---------------------

The graphical interface provides several monitoring panels, including:

* Overall robot state
* Navigation goal status
* Robot pose
* Motion state
* Active LiDAR monitoring field
* Hardware connection
* Emergency stop status
* Manual override state
* Speed limit
* IMU measurements
* Front and rear warning and protective field status
* Velocity command chain
* Topic watchdog
* Live linear velocity plots
* Live angular velocity plots

Architecture
------------

The application consists of two main components:

* A ROS 2 monitoring node that subscribes to the required ROS interfaces.
* A PyQt6 graphical user interface that visualizes the received data in real time.

Communication between both components is implemented using a dedicated worker thread and Qt signals to ensure a responsive user interface during continuous ROS communication.
